name: Vapin Ape | 1g Full Spectrum Pod Starter Kit | Black Cherry Kush
description:
All Vapin Ape "Starter Kits" come with a Vapin Ape Pod System Battery.

Black Cherry Kush (True Hybrid) is a smooth disposable vape blending juicy cherry and slightly sour flavors with woody undertones. Its dominant terpenes—caryophyllene, limonene, and terpinolene—offer a balanced experience with a clear head, body buzz, and serene effects. Taste & Aroma: Juicy cherry, Slightly sour, Woody undertones. Effect: Clear head, Body buzz, Serenity
